subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: A book a storehouse of knowledge It is to keep himself immortal in this world Mortal man wants the role of a good friend A good book plays a real friend of man one of the best means to immortalize him on earth So, undoubtedly a good book after his physical death
guide_solution: (a) A book a real friend of man. (b) It is a storehouse of knowledge. (c) Mortal man wants to keep himself immortal in this world. (d) A good book plays the role of a good friend. (e) So, undoubtedly a good book is one of the best means to immortalize him on earth after his physical death.
